prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Specific wait-step status indicators (+14.7% measured) and diagnostic screens (+6.1% measured) were helpful, with predictions (+14.0% and +3.5%) slightly too low, though other wait-info additions and new screens showed no clear effect.
Specific callout tips (+9.2% and +9.6% measured) and path discovery layout redesigns (+9.5% measured) were helpful, and predictions (+4.5%, +2.0%, -1.0%) were significantly too low; other hints showed no clear effect.
Certain intro redesigns can significantly harm performance (Compact Card Home Intro Redesign: -17.5% measured), while most other redesigns and layout changes showed no clear effect, making positive predictions (+1.0% to +12.0%) too optimistic.
Deferring account sign-in (-7.3% measured) and path outcome copy optimization (-6.6% measured) significantly harmed performance; predictions (+15.0% and +1.5%) were far too high.
Copy refinements and banners showed no clear effect or significantly harmed performance, and predictions were consistently too optimistic.

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Live Wait Step Generation Progress Timer: Displays a live dynamic countdown timer and detailed status updates on the waiting screen during companion asset generation. (why: The waiting step has a long mean time of 2336s (median 201s), where users drop off without clear expectations on remaining time.)
1: [choose_path, hint] Companion Path Choice Callout Tip: Adds an inline hint on the path selection screen clarifying that pet traits and behaviors can be customized later in app settings. (why: Choose path step mean time is 514s (median 8s), indicating high drop-off and hesitation when users decide on their onboarding path.)
2: [finish, copy] System Tray Quick Control Desktop Guidance Copy: Updates the home_intro screen headline and body text with clear guidance on system tray access and quick pet controls. (why: Multiple support tickets report confusion post-onboarding regarding how to interact with, talk to, or hide their pet from the screen.)

scores.note: Wait step dynamic timers and status indicators have strong historical success and address severe funnel duration drop-off.
Inline callout tips clarifying path choices directly target drop-off hesitation and historically yield strong positive lift.
Copy refinements consistently show neutral or negative performance across historical onboarding tests.
